name: shopify-storefront-graphql
title: Shopify Storefront GraphQL
summary: The Shopify Storefront GraphQL API 2026-10 for a myshopify.com store: products and variants, collections, menus, pages, recommendations, and a cart that holds together (cartCreate, cartLinesAdd merging a variant's lines, cartLinesUpdate with quantity 0 removing, cartLinesRemove, totals computed from the lines).

upstream.notes: Shopify publishes no Storefront API schema as an openly licensed file. The full schema ships as introspection JSON (storefront.schema.json in the @shopify/hydrogen-react npm package); this example neither vendors nor pins it, so the hand-written subset is the only contract. It keeps Shopify's type, field and argument names; ProductVariant.product is nullable here (Shopify: non-null) so a cart line can hold a variant without its whole product.

body.query: mutation { cartCreate { cart { id checkoutUrl totalQuantity cost { totalAmount { amount currencyCode } } } userErrors { message } } }
